failure_taxonomy.ARTIFACT_INVALID: accepted strict L1a artifact validation failed
failure_taxonomy.GEOMETRY_INVALID: geometry v1.1 or manufacturability validation failed
failure_taxonomy.SAMPLING_FAILURE: accepted bounded sampler could not construct a design
failure_taxonomy.SOLVER_FAILURE: Warp solve raised or did not satisfy true residual

limitations: No thrust, efficiency, Isp, plasma, thermal, or structural quantity is calculated.
Equivalent current bands are a non-authoritative geometry preview.
Finite Dirichlet-boundary FDM and sampled topology remain screening-level.
No result is hardware-valid or build-qualified.

qoi_policy.boundary_ratio: maximum sampled non-axis outer-boundary |B| / global sampled peak |B|
qoi_policy.claim_limit: sampled-grid descriptors only; null interpolation is not a continuous critical-point proof
qoi_policy.field_energy: axisymmetric trapezoidal integral of B^2/(2*mu0) over the domain
qoi_policy.fixed_locations: nearest grid nodes at axis/chamber midpoint, axis/injector exit, axis/divergent-exit start, and chamber-radius/chamber midpoint
qoi_policy.mirror_ratio: for each adjacent stage pair: larger absolute axis Bz at the two stage centres divided by max(abs(Bz at gap midpoint), topology tolerance)
qoi_policy.source_representation_error: maximum of per-band relative ampere-turn error, relative overlap-area error, and centroid error divided by minimum band thickness
qoi_policy.stage_gradient: centred axis-Bz finite difference at each stage centre

sampling.algorithm: accepted deterministic shifted-Halton with boundary challenges
